product.title: Front Office City: NFL Capital Run
product.summary: The same 3D city, rebuilt for the NFL and rotated across three roles.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students pick a difficulty and one of two teams, then rotate through agent, league office and owner roles across missions on holdouts, compliance, tampering, revenue allocation and franchise valuation, trading cap room against trust, and finish with a per-role report and a review checksum.
product.technology: modular vanilla JS with a 3D world, no build step

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: Two passing test suites, GitHub Actions CI, a documented mission matrix and a deterministic balance harness — the strongest engineering in the Front Office City family. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: No GitHub Pages deployment (404); CI runs tests but does not publish. No live instance found.
knownBlockers: No deployment, so an instructor cannot run it today.
Claim codes are prefixed 'M1-201-NFL-' in the Module 2 repo, an unresolved naming carry-over.

provenance.evidence: M2-201-FINAL/README.md: 'NFL-only 3D front-office simulation for middle school learners (7th/8th grade).' docs/mission-matrix.md lists missions such as 'AGENT-002 | Training Camp Holdout Threat'. CI at .github/workflows/ci.yml runs npm test on push.
